sharedRules.scope: All additions below are NEW scoped next25 proposals requiring actual GPT conference. They do not alter the source records, existing accepted spells or the global geometry/interrupt engine. Original exact records and all actual class access are embedded per spell.
sharedRules.casting: Use the chosen actual class/school/rank access, minimum class level and independently acquired repertoire in completeSourceAndAccess. Base RP remains the exact class row (r4 7, r5 10, r6 13, r7 17, r8 21, r9 26). All actual additional costs, Dissonance, Refrain, components, normal concentration transitions and cast-begin hooks commit before interruption. No generic upcast, new Action, optional class exception or permission follows from having RP. A later counter, immunity, blocked payload or failed save refunds nothing. Components remain actual Core V/S/F except Circle of Death retains V/S/M-or-F; its M alternative needs its source item, and no invented component cost is added. Mental Bomb is a Reaction; other25 casts are Actions. The reaction trigger is explicitly NEW below, not an inherited Core fact.
sharedRules.digitalGeometry: NEW scoped geometry for these25 cards: use actual world-space 3D occupied body volumes and Euclidean feet, not display sprites or the historical grid diagonal metric. Single-target range is the nearest actual caster-to-target body distance. A chosen area center must be a perceived point within the stated range from the actual caster body, with originating line of effect. A creature qualifies only if at least one actual body point intersects the closed specified volume and has line of effect from the relevant area origin/center. Tangency counts as intersection. Total cover prevents that application. Fix the whole recipient set and geometry after cast interruptions and before damage; destroying cover gives no second scan. Friendly targets and the caster are included whenever an ALL-creature shape actually includes them; ENEMIES means creatures the caster already ordinarily identifies as enemies at this snapshot, with no hidden-hostility or faction scan. No spell title creates an object-targeting permission.
sharedRules.lineAndCone: NEW scoped templates: a line is a closed finite cylinder of the printed length and5ft diameter, with flat end caps, from a chosen point on the caster exterior in a declared unit direction. The origin must be real, not an offset remote point; exclude only the casting body from its own line. Cone of Cold uses a closed right circular cone of axial length60ft and half-angle30degrees, apex at that same real exterior point, excluding the casting body. Its base radius is60*tan(30degrees). This proposal resolves previously unspecified widths/angles only for the named next25 lines/cone; it does not change Burning Hands, Thunderwave or any accepted spell. Cube sides are30ft for Horrid Wilting; choose its center and orientation before commitment, then its actual snapshot before damage. No range-to-far-edge rule is invented for a point-centered area.
sharedRules.saveAndDamage: A specified save uses8+PB+the real casting modifier under the actual placement/class and actual modifiers. Save outcomes are binary, not degrees; save damage never criticals. For each card use exactly its success branch, not a universal half-damage default. Unless a card expressly says per-target, use one shared raw pool for its area/chain and separate recipient damage packets, roots and actual defenses. Elemental Devastation explicitly rolls separately per enemy. Mixed typed parts of one actual hit stay one damage event for Wound/zero/lifecycle consequences; the unresolved exact mixed-type defense apportionment is flagged separately, not fabricated. Halve each specified raw typed part with floor only when that card says half, before applicable defenses. Apply ordinary real damage, temporary HP, Wounds, zero/death/Stable/Dying and source-specific callbacks once. No creature type supplies an unprinted blanket mental or damage immunity.
sharedRules.rootsAndSuppression: At the actual permitted damage application create each recipient root under the accepted creation-time dealer/Null rules, even when the RNG pool is shared. Caster is the dealer for these direct spells; an arc origin is not a new dealer. Separate recipients and genuinely separate casts keep distinct roots. Apply current Lesser Antimagic, Globe and genuine defenses to actual payload locus/origin/rank. Globe blocks only its covered incoming rank0–5 application; rank6+ is outside that ceiling. An initially prevented rider does not establish or wait for later suppression ending. Established condition records retain identity, clocks and spent history through suppression; expired/ended records never replay. Completed instantaneous damage is not dispellable after the fact. No attack, roll, concentration, resource or root is manufactured by presentation or reentry.
sharedRules.control: Stunned and Paralyzed attempt independent hard-denial components under the accepted one-source-character/target/encounter guard; a prior spent guard prevents only that new hard component with no unprinted fallback. A failed save can still resolve independent damage. Damage-type immunity does not prevent a separately legal condition, and condition immunity does not prevent damage. Establishment spends the hard guard once; no later recast, source rename, suppression or expiration refunds it. Prone, Blinded, Frightened and the explicit limited Reaction/movement losses use their actual narrower scope; they do not acquire hard-denial immunity by association.
sharedRules.duration: For the newly specified hostile one-target-round riders below, record the target first future original regular END, excluding a target turn already underway; for Frozen Tomb two-round Paralyzed use its second future original regular END. Preserve that marker/virtual mapping through reorder, absence, extra turns and travel. If begun outside initiative use application+6 or+12 seconds respectively and retain the absolute deadline on entry. END processing precedes expiry cleanup under the accepted typed clock. No repeat save is granted unless the specific card supplies one. For a creature with only owner-attached phases, these spells do not manufacture a regular turn: NEW finite duration fallback is the corresponding6N elapsed seconds from application, with no command/action/recharge/death-save phase. This exact duration-only extension needs conference. Prone ends under its actual stand/cure rule, with no invented timer.
sharedRules.recordsAndCleanup: Record exact generating spell ID, school/rank, class/source owner, cast/event order, target, components, saved outcome, source DC, initial/root IDs, actual absolute or typed deadline, concentration link, spent guard and suppression state. Different paid casts keep independent records and do not add condition magnitude; deleting/ending one never removes another. A successfully established same-owner named condition can retain independent source records here; it cannot bypass a hard guard or trigger duplicate ticks. Death/ended identity, actual removal, duration or concentration ends only the covered application. Destroyed/ended creature identities are not silently recreated. Damage types and names add no Burning/Frozen, ice shell, soul, plane, alignment, faction or automatic environmental effect absent that card’s actual printed promise.

If absent, record one pending cancellation of the next ordinary regular-START Reaction refresh at its original next future START; expire after processing that refresh, even if the target could not act. No schedule: pending cancellation expires after6 elapsed seconds without inventing a refresh. It never removes separately granted special Reactions or resets a resource. Missing phase, different plane, suppression, zero Speed, blocked route or no safe path consumes the check and expires the instruction without retry. Single-target range is the nearest actual caster-to-target body distance. A chosen area center must be a perceived point within the stated range from the actual caster body, with originating line of effect. A creature qualifies only if at least one actual body point intersects the closed specified volume and has line of effect from the relevant area origin/center. Tangency counts as intersection. Total cover prevents that application. Fix the whole recipient set and geometry after cast interruptions and before damage; destroying cover gives no second scan. Friendly targets and the caster are included whenever an ALL-creature shape actually includes them; ENEMIES means creatures the caster already ordinarily identifies as enemies at this snapshot, with no hidden-hostility or faction scan. No spell title creates an object-targeting permission. NEW scoped templates: a line is a closed finite cylinder of the printed length and5ft diameter, with flat end caps, from a chosen point on the caster exterior in a declared unit direction. The origin must be real, not an offset remote point; exclude only the casting body from its own line. Cone of Cold uses a closed right circular cone of axial length60ft and half-angle30degrees, apex at that same real exterior point, excluding the casting body. Its base radius is60*tan(30degrees). This proposal resolves previously unspecified widths/angles only for the named next25 lines/cone; it does not change Burning Hands, Thunderwave or any accepted spell. Cube sides are30ft for Horrid Wilting; choose its center and orientation before commitment, then its actual snapshot before damage. No range-to-far-edge rule is invented for a point-centered area.
